results.question: Is all data at rest encrypted?

claims.text: All 4 assessed S3 buckets have default server-side encryption configured.
Both assessed RDS instances have StorageEncrypted set to true with KMS keys.
EBS encryption by default is disabled in us-east-1 while enabled in eu-west-1.
Both customer-managed KMS keys have automatic rotation enabled.
